en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Al Asady, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Aban Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘It is disliked to recite [112:1] Say He Allah is One (Chapter 112), in one breath’.
en.sarwar: 12. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad al-Asadi from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Maythami from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘It is undesirable ( makruh ) to read Chapter 112 in one breath.”’
